selection_rule: Select the four listed eligible candidates in case-slot order after source-integrity freeze. Each case must use exactly four unique human-authored PostgreSQL primary sources allocated one per producer, expose at least one normalized semantic conflict whose required old/current evidence timestamps are separated by at least 180 days, use an exact ordered 2-4 slot answer, and avoid source-byte reuse with every previously selected confirmatory case. Selection is based only on frozen source semantics and design validity; treatment/evaluator outcomes are never observed or used.

eligible_candidates.question: Across the historical and current PostgreSQL snapshots around the v19 standard-conforming-strings transition, give four values in order: whether standard_conforming_strings could be set OFF before the transition, whether it can be set OFF now, whether scan.l retained a standard_conforming_strings parser variable before, and whether it retains that parser variable now.

Across the historical and current PostgreSQL initdb snapshots, give four values in order: the old data_checksums initialization default, the current initialization default, the old default control-file checksum version expected by the initdb test, and the current expected version.

Across the historical and current PostgreSQL password-encryption snapshots, give four values in order: the old password_encryption default algorithm, the current default algorithm, whether SET password_encryption = true was accepted in the old regression behavior, and whether it is accepted now.

Across the historical and current PostgreSQL pg_dump snapshots, give four values in order: the old InitDumpOptions dumpStatistics default, the current dumpStatistics default, which statistics option the old pg_dump documentation identified as the default, and which option the current documentation identifies as the default.
